ingestion.description: Nightly: finds UK hedge-care sources (video or written) and creates a story-led (case-study opening) How-To article for each, matching Margate/Thanet species and conditions. Morning: audits the full site.
ingestion.structuralAngle: story-led / case-study - every article opens with a short real-feeling job scenario before the practical detail. See TEMPLATES/how-to.md. This is the site's ring-wide anti-fingerprinting assignment; do not drift to a generic hero-first shape.
categories: Seasonal hedge care and nesting-season timing
ingestion.hubGrowthMechanism: static .grid.grid-2 of .card elements, no data-howto-cat filter system (unlike sandwichhedges.co.uk) - add a new card in reading order
ingestion.jsonLdPattern: flat Article object (author: Person 'Richard Lim', publisher: Organization) - NOT @graph, NOT HowTo. See TEMPLATES/how-to.md section 2.
ingestion.relatedGuidesConvention: none - no JET-RELATED-GUIDES comment blocks on this site; use plain in-text <a> cross-links instead

nightly.name: Nightly content finder
nightly.description: Find up to 3 UK hedge-care sources, generate story-led articles, commit + push.

morning.name: Morning site audit
morning.description: Audit every page: hub-grid integrity, broken links, dead videos, SEO, story-led compliance, relevance.
